elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Vendor expressly “shall defend” Customer and its Affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Vendor shall indemnify Customer and its Affiliates from and against “any third-party claim” arising from the listed triggers.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: The indemnity covers allegations that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) expressly covers “Vendor's breach of Applicable Law.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause (d) expressly covers Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must give prompt written notice of a claim, subject to a material-prejudice qualification.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying Party controls the defence with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Customer's indemnity is limited to claims arising from content or materials Customer provides or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims alleging infringement or misappropriation by the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The IP indemnity excludes claims arising from Customer's unauthorized modification of the Services or a Deliverable.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: The IP indemnity excludes claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not otherwise have arisen.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: The IP indemnity excludes claims arising from Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: Vendor must procure continued use or modify or replace the affected item with functionally equivalent non-infringing material.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: If those remedies are not commercially feasible, Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the terminated period and Fees paid for the affected Deliverable.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees cap appears; Section 21.3 instead identifies indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims.
